name: Tasklist (SA)
help: Lists running processes; remote queries are available on Windows only.
long_help: On Windows, queries Win32_Process through WMI on the local or selected remote system and returns name, PID, PPID, session ID, and command line. On Linux and macOS, lists only local processes with name/command path, PID, and PPID; remote queries, session IDs, and full command lines are not supported, and a nonempty resource argument is rejected.

arguments.name: resource
arguments.desc: WMI resource path, e.g. \\.\root\cimv2 (local) or \\HOST\root\cimv2 (remote). Empty for local default
